run_verify_python_release_cli: run the verify_python_release script with a version and optional package list to verify PyPI artifacts
run_get_md5_checksum: run _get_md5_checksum to calculate the MD5 hash of a given file
run_get_local_artifacts: run _get_local_artifacts to get a set of Artifact namedtuples for all files in the current directory
run_get_remote_artifacts_for_package: run _get_remote_artifacts_for_package to fetch artifact filenames and MD5 digests from PyPI for a package version
run_verify_release: run _verify_release to compare local artifacts against PyPI uploaded artifacts and report mismatches
